notes: This is a comprehensive theoretical and experimental review of the Casimir effect (arXiv:quant-ph/0106045). The paper discusses vacuum energy, quantum field theory regularization, and measurements of Casimir forces between conducting plates and other geometries. While Section 7 briefly mentions 'constraints for non-Newtonian gravity from the Casimir effect,' the paper is NOT primarily about dark matter, axions, dark photons, or ultralight dark matter searches. The Casimir effect is a quantum vacuum phenomenon arising from zero-point electromagnetic energy, distinct from dark matter coupling searches. No exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling, dark photon kinetic mixing, or other dark sector parameters are presented.
